companion: {companion} gazes at {name} with a knowing warmth. The bond between 道侣 (Dao Companions) hums like a plucked zither string.
{companion} leans close, voice low: 'The Heavens are jealous of what we share. Let them be.'
A cherry blossom settles on {companion}'s sleeve as they stand watch over {name}'s cultivation. Some guards are softer than others.
{companion} gifts {name} a talisman folded from an ancient leaf. It smells of pine and centuries.
In the quiet after battle, {companion} and {name} sit back to back, their qi circulating in a single slow breath.
{companion} hums a folk song of the mortal world — and for a moment, even the 心魔 (Heart Demon) in {name} falls silent.
{companion} measures {name}'s pulse with spiritual sense, frowning at the turbulence. 'You push too hard, 道侣 (Dao Companion).'
Distant thunder. {companion} tightens their grip on {name}'s hand. 'Whatever comes next, we face it together.'
